title: Constructions and automorphisms of quandles
summary: We prove that if M is an abelian group and X = Alex(M, phi) is a Latin Alexander quandle with id - phi in Aut(M), then Aut(X) is isomorphic to M semidirect C_Aut(M)(phi), Inn(X) is isomorphic to M semidirect and Out(X) is isomorphic to C_Aut(M)(phi)/ . As a consequence, we obtain a description of the automorphism groups of direct products of the cyclic commutative medial quandles C_{2n+1} and the dihedral quandles R_{2n+1}, and we find their orders.
